_scale.formality: TONE, not construction. 0 = casual, playful, personal · 1 = serious, official, suited to long formal text. Blocky or geometric display fonts are informal even though they look 'built'.
_scale.quirkiness: 0 = standard, conventional shapes · 1 = highly stylized or decorative. Anchors from the user's review: 站酷庆科黄油体 0.7, 站酷快乐体 0.45.
_scale.how: Scored by looking at similarity/specimens/<id>.png. The user's corrections live in overrides.json and win over these.
_scale.display: 0 = made for reading body text · 1 = made for headlines, posters, logos. Heavy display fonts (得意黑, 庆科黄油体, 快乐体) read as their own group, far from text fonts.

noto-sans-sc.why: The neutral reference sans: even strokes, square frames, nothing personal. Default for UI and signage.

smiley-sans.why: Trendy branding sans: slanted and condensed. Clean, but its tone is lively rather than serious.

lxgw-marker-gothic.why: Marker-drawn gothic with chisel-cut ends: tidy, but its tone is casual and hand-made.

noto-serif-sc.why: Classic book 宋体: the most serious, official tone in the set.

lxgw-neo-zhisong.why: Traditional Song text face with a bookish, old-style flavour; very orderly.

zhuque-fangsong.why: 仿宋: the face of official documents; calm calligraphic warmth.

lxgw-wenkai.why: 楷 text face: brush-derived but calm and readable. (User override: 0.75.)

ma-shan-zheng.why: Brush 楷书: traditional and orderly, but with visible ink and weight; ceremonial more than official.

zhi-mang-xing.why: 行书 (running script): connected, energetic strokes; artistic headings rather than text.

liu-jian-mao-cao.why: 草书 (cursive): fast, heavily abbreviated; expressive and hard to read at text size.

long-cang.why: Casual brush handwriting: uneven sizes and slants, but legible.

xiaolai.why: Felt-pen handwriting: round ends, wobbly boxes, friendly. (User override: 0.35.)

yozai.why: Neat pen handwriting with round ends: casual, but calmer and more regular than 小赖.

lxgw-975yuan.why: Rounded gothic: the structure of a text sans with softened ends; friendly but still suitable for body text.

resource-han-rounded.why: 思源黑体 with every corner rounded: neutral structure, gentler tone.

zcool-kuaile.why: Playful display face: chamfered corners, bouncy proportions, heavy strokes. (User override: quirkiness 0.45.)

zcool-qingke-huangyou.why: Stylized geometric display with rounded corners and reshaped components; fun, not formal. (User overrides.)

zcool-xiaowei.why: Elegant logo/display face: Song-like contrast, sharp wedges, unusual proportions.
